Example service

This service page explains who it is for: a small business that records sales in a notebook and wants one place for stock, invoices and follow-up. It lists three concrete deliverables and the three steps of setup, so a reader can decide whether it fits.

Setup starts with a short call, then a configuration session, then a review of imported records with the owner. The page states that supported tools depend on the country and that human review is required for AI-assisted output.

It links back to the home page and to the French version where one exists. There is no invented client story or statistic on this page.
